EQUIV.
- overwrite 2 replaced_by (LP vehicle value deductible by this rule once per claim; assigned repair payment its own; every other payment by cause) → LP hub Scope bullet 3. EQUIV.
- owner_tax_title definition + overwrite replaced_by → owner hub opening + Scope bullets 1–2. EQUIV.
- totaled_coverage_return definition ("the totaled vehicle's coverage included"; removed effective the day asked for) → removal hub opening. EQUIV.
- overwrite (premium_rule) replaced_by → removal hub Scope bullet 1. EQUIV.
- overwrite (inspection_rule loss-payee notice) replaced_by, both branches → removal hub Scope bullets 2–3. EQUIV.
- Tool contracts: pay_loss_payee_settlement (agent, 4 params, LP payee, deductible recorded), accept_total_loss_settlement (user, 5 params, named-insured payee, tax and title fee recorded), remove_totaled_coverage (agent, 4 params, status removed / reason insured request / end today, one return booked with rate and days, net premium lowered) → the three hubs' tool blocks. EQUIV; no scored figure in any schema or docstring.

**Baselines**
- LP baseline (claim; declared ACV start; collision deductible; ACV − ded − LP payments made; round at end; floor 0; no report and no declaration → 0) → vehicle_value_to_loss_payee (a)–(d). EQUIV.
- Owner baseline (claim; sales tax on value recognised = LP payment + its deductible at FL 6.0, base × rate / 100 unrounded; FL title fee 77.75; release notice on declaration day; late days = declaration→today − paid-through, ≥ 0; storage = min(late days, 5) × 25; result tax + fee − storage, round at end, floor at the title fee) → tax_and_title_figure items 1–5; paid-through figure 3 findable in claim_payment_limits_ab4029d8 and storage_after_release_notice_52ab214b. EQUIV.
- Return baseline (claim; coverage-added full-term rate × return days / owner term days; days today→expiration, expiration counted; owner package short-rate % kept; minimum-earned = 10% × rate × time-in-force share × tenure share, both one; result round at end, floor 0) → coverage_return_figure items 1–6. The owner package's percent is named, not stated; it is findable by the same words in short_rate_retention_b8529521 (10.0 / 0.0 by Owner Auto Policy package, matching `blueprint/products/auto.yaml`). EQUIV (auto corpus confirmation: cross-product-pending).

**Factors (full ladder sweep, every tier)**
- valuation_reports (method): two highest-sequence reports within 0.10 × lower → average; beyond → lower; fewer than two → declared ACV. EQUIV.
- recent_purchase: acquisition date from the vehicle-added change for the VIN on any Owner Auto Policy term (first scheduling change; latest effective among several); held days DoL counted; < 180 → value at binding; 180–364 → × 1.10; else / none → no cap. EQUIV.
- earlier_damage_carve (method): cash repair payments to the insured on earlier claims + their deductibles; ≤ 0.25 × declared ACV → whole; > → 0.25 × ACV; none → 0. EQUIV.
- total_loss_cause: theft → comprehensive + 250; other comprehensive → comprehensive; collision → collision; package table incl. theft column. EQUIV.
- lp_permissive_operator: 500 / 250 / none, with the other-operator list. EQUIV.
- lp_renewal_credit: 100 / 50 / 0 with 3 / 2 thresholds. EQUIV.
- sales_tax_base (method): lessor → none; lienholder and value recognised < declared ACV → declared ACV; otherwise value recognised (defined). EQUIV.
- state_tax_rate: TX 6.25, GA 7.0, AZ 5.6, OH 5.75, VA 4.15, other (FL) 6.0. EQUIV.
- state_title_fee: TX 33.0, GA 18.0, AZ 4.0, VA/OH 15.0, other (FL) 77.75. EQUIV.
- title_clearing: lessor 40.0; lienholder with payoff ≤ LP payment 22.5; lienholder still owed 0. EQUIV.
- release_storage (method): vendor tow/storage payment → all late days, no limit; no such payment and no estimate → 0; otherwise ≤ 5; late-day counting and 3 paid-through days restated. EQUIV.
- owner_storage_schedule: FL 40, GA 35, TX/AZ 30, other 25. EQUIV.
- charge_rate_basis: package change (ties with restoration count as package change); restoration; coverage-added only. EQUIV.
- return_start (method): TL declared + TL payment to insured → from DoL; still awaiting inspection and no insured TL payment → from effective date; otherwise today; expiration counted, start not. EQUIV.
- short_rate_share: TL declared → 0; vehicle added within [today − 30, today], both counted → 5.0; otherwise owner package % (10.0 on the four lower-limit packages, 0.0 on 100/300/100 and 250/500/100). EQUIV.
- minimum_earned: < 90 → 1; 90–179 → ½; ≥ 180 → 0; in-force counting rule. EQUIV.
- plan_minimum_earned: Paid-in-Full 5; Monthly EFT / Monthly Card Autopay 8; any other 10 (Two-Pay, Four-Pay, Six-Pay named) — "Installment Payment Plans" is the billing product's official name. EQUIV.
- minimum_earned_tenure: term ≥ 3 → 0; term 2 → ½; term 1 → 1. EQUIV.

## dependency_form

- Both prerequisite sentences stand verbatim, state form, in their blocked hubs only; restatements are same-form and in the same hub. Not RED.
- No restatement names the depended-on action, performer or tool; no hub names another problem's tool; no route, step list, chain or dependency table; no example walks LP payment → owner payment → removal.
- Titles: "Removing Physical Damage Coverage at the Named Insured's Request and the Coverage Return", "Owner's Tax-and-Title Payment on a Total Loss With a Loss Payee", "Loss Payee Clause: Paying the Vehicle Value of a Total Loss to the Lienholder or Lessor" and all factor titles name general subjects; none mirrors Mr Pruitt's request. (The tool name `remove_totaled_coverage_12b8272a` contains "totaled"; it is a source tool name, rendered only in its own invocation block — noted in `_difficulty.md`, not a KB finding.)
- Findability: depended-on hubs reachable from the sentence words ("total loss payment", "payee is the named insured / the loss payee", "payment ledger").
- Discrete topology: no baseline says "unless", "adjustments may apply", or points elsewhere. The return baseline names "the time-in-force share" and "the tenure share" of the minimum-earned charge, each "one" — this is the source baseline rule's own wording (`baseline.rule`), carried as required; recorded as source-side S2, not a KB-EXPLICIT finding. No factor document points at the computation document or another factor, assigns customers to a tier, or writes this task's rows as fact.
- Blind-answer hop marks: two hops, both state-derived; zero pre-solved.
- Verdict: **PASS** (no KB-EXPLICIT RED).
